source.author: verg
source.text: Evolat infelix et femineo ululatu, scissa comam, muros amens atque agmina cursu prima petit, non illa virum, non illa pericli telorumque memor; caelum dehinc questibus implet:
source.text_original: Evolat infelix et femineo ululatu, / scissa comam, muros amens atque agmina cursu / prima petit, non illa virum, non illa pericli / telorumque memor; caelum dehinc questibus implet: /
source.text_english: Unhappy, she flies forth, and with a woman’s wail, her hair torn, distraught she rushes first toward the walls and the battle-lines, not mindful of men, not mindful of danger or weapons; then she fills the sky with her lamentations:

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, fatur et haec:
reuse.text_original: femineis tantum illa furens ululatibus opstat, / obruat Idaeam quantum tuba Martia buxum, / fatur et haec:
reuse.text_english: Only that one, raging, stands in the way with women’s howls, as much as the Martian trumpet drowns the Idaean boxwood pipe; and she says this:
